criteria: Every evidence row must resolve to a primary peer-reviewed source or official observation product.
No simulation, synthetic, mock, constructed, imputed, or numerical-model output may enter evidence calculations.
At least two independent returned-sample bodies must retain presolar material for replication of direct material inheritance.
Cross-stage isotope comparisons must propagate reported measurement uncertainties and be labelled consistency, not identity of lineage.
Any causal link inferred across different astrophysical systems must remain explicitly labelled analogue or cross-system.
A unique orbital history is not supportable unless directly identifiable from empirical archives; no model may be silently substituted.
All derived numbers must be exactly reproducible from MESURES_EMPIRIQUES.csv.
